text:
elsa: Hey team — new user hit a blocker trying the Ruby sample app during onboarding. Gemfile pins bundler ~> 2.3 but their workstation has bundler 2.4 and `bundle install` fails with lockfile mismatch.

elsa: Minimal repro: clone sample, ruby 3.2, run `bundle install` -> error: "You must use Bundler 2.3.x to install this project". They expect the sample to work with latest bundler.

ben: Ugh. We pinned bundler in the sample to avoid CI differences but that hurts DX. Quick question: do we want the samples to be strict (repro exact env) or permissive (work with modern toolchains)?

maintainer-ryan: IMO samples should be permissive for onboarding. Lockfiles are useful for app templates, but dev samples should prefer widest compatibility. Suggest: remove the bundler pin and add a short note in README about recommended bundler versions and `bundle update --bundler` if needed.

elsa: I hacked a tiny PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-samples/pull/9 — removes bundler constraint, updates README, adds a CI matrix job for bundler 2.3/2.4.

ben: can you also add a tiny check in CI that `bundle install` succeeds on both matrix entries? avoids regressions.

ci-bot: CI: matrix job ruby-3.2 / bundler-2.4 failed on first run due to flakey gem mirror timeout. Suggested: rerun job. :repeat:

maintainer-ryan: Added `bundle install --jobs=4 --retry=3` to the workflow to harden against mirror flakiness. Also added an entry to CHANGELOG under "developer experience" describing the change.

pm-liz: Important for product: onboarding success ties to conversion. If this is just a docs tweak + CI changes, can we roll it out as a patch to the sample repo and announce in the #new-hires channel?

elsa: will do the announcement after merge. One more nit: we intentionally used `REDWOOD_API_KEY` in the sample env but our docs usually use `REDWOOD_KEY`. I updated the sample to accept either env var for convenience.

ben: Nice. LGTM once CI passes. If CI flakes again we can fallback to a small containerized dev image note in README.

maintainer-ryan: Merged and cut sample release v0.1.3 with the changes. Released notes: "Relax Bundler pin, broaden onboarding compatibility, CI matrix added".

pm-liz: Thanks — can someone add a short blurb in the onboarding checklist about running `bundle update --bundler` if they hit errors? I'll add to the playbook.

elsa: Added checklist item and posted announcement to #new-hires. Marking this resolved. :white_check_mark:
